g.text: S03-ddd-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
Resolve the system before loading the target user and checking department scope.
[no outer read-only transaction (S03 HTTP takes this path)]
[until the version is stable or three attempts are used]
Catch this target-side error and use empty Effective.
Skip disabled roles and preserve distinct paths.
[target user active and no active transaction]
Cache the candidate for this version.
A version change before or after writing starts the next attempt.
An unchanged final version ends the loop with the candidate result.
Same retry algorithm in REQUIRES_NEW / READ_COMMITTED / readOnly.
Clear the JPA context at the start of each attempt and skip all cache access.
